notes: Voice chat: press Esc on a server and pick Nearby or Global in the top right. Hold V to talk.
Emoji: type :sob: :skull: :fire: :heart: and 100 more in chat and they turn into emoji, drawn in Minecraft's own font.
Mods: a new Mods button on the title screen. Add JavaScript mods from a file or a link, turn them on or off, or try the example mod.
Edit Profile: Import/Export works now - back up your skin, settings and servers to a file and load them back.
Edit Profile keeps your changes if the window is resized while you are editing.
